I would like to ask you regarding the permissibility of children (na-baligh) standing in the rows of adults in the masjid. In our masjid (in London, UK), 2 groups seem to have developed. 1 group says it is necessary for the children to stand in the rows at the back of the congregation during salaat, whereas the other says children should/can stand within the adult rows. Both groups quote different ulama to support their views. answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 27461 Country: India Title: Pls inform me if a wife can wear the lingere (that she has worn at the time of intercourse and that no impurities / semen is found on the clothing / lingere) during the course of the day OR during offering namaaz???? Is it mandatory for her to change her clothing at the time of namaaz? Pls advice me. Thanks and best regards Question: As-salaam-alikum, Pls inform me if a wife can wear the lingere (that she has worn at the time of intercourse and that no impurities / semen is found on the clothing / lingere) during the course of the day OR during offering namaaz???? Is it mandatory for her to change her clothing at the time of namaaz? Pls advice me. Thanks and best regards Answer ID: 27461 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1652/1652/M=1431) If no impurity is smeared on the said clothes and the part of body is covered completely, you can offer salah in that clothes. It is not necessary to change the clothes at the time of salah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
